possibilities.title: PAGC base-inventory resolution
possibilities.why_it_exists: The source-derived base count is unresolved and blocks E6, 27-base, and 216-token claims.
possibilities.first_principles_basis: A finite symbol inventory can be counted from primary source artifacts before any theory is built on it.
possibilities.novelty_hypothesis: A rigorous source-first count may separate decolonial knowledge-system claims from numerological overreach.
possibilities.next_test: Audit Azuonye 1992 PDF and chart transcription line-by-line.

possibilities.title: Scaled compression falsification for k=27
possibilities.why_it_exists: The small-corpus sweep refutes k=27 but requires replication on larger corpora.
possibilities.first_principles_basis: If 27 is a structural optimum, the optimum should be robust across corpus scale and baselines.
possibilities.novelty_hypothesis: The result may become a useful negative finding about culturally inspired tokenization claims.
possibilities.next_test: Replicate BPE sweep on larger documented Igbo corpus and add MDL baselines.

possibilities.title: Non-circular bounded-memory experiment
possibilities.why_it_exists: The current memory simulation is invalidated as circular.
possibilities.first_principles_basis: An encoder should succeed on invariants not embedded in its own representation rule.
possibilities.novelty_hypothesis: A careful null-model comparison could clarify whether bounded symbolic memory has real adaptation value.
possibilities.next_test: Design fixtures with non-aligned invariant structure and random-hash controls.

possibilities.title: ICEGOV evidence-gate reconciliation
possibilities.why_it_exists: Active papers exist, but deadline/format drift and evidence gaps threaten submission readiness.
possibilities.first_principles_basis: A paper cannot be submission-ready if its gate state, venue constraints, and claim evidence disagree.
possibilities.novelty_hypothesis: A machine-readable gate audit can become a reusable research-lab contribution.
possibilities.next_test: Diff portfolio, runtime manifests, promote gates, source gaps, and submission rules.

possibilities.title: Research Spine computability dry run
possibilities.why_it_exists: The Spine promises product-to-research evidence routing but needs dry-run validation.
possibilities.first_principles_basis: Indicators are only research evidence when their data dependencies are computable and logged.
possibilities.novelty_hypothesis: A computability-first governance indicator pipeline may be a strong method contribution.
possibilities.next_test: Run extractor against synthetic read-only fixtures, not production data.

possibilities.title: Repo-level citation and claim auditor
possibilities.why_it_exists: The repo already has many paper harnesses and source registries but lacks a unified claim audit.
possibilities.first_principles_basis: No unsupported claims requires a machine-checkable relation between claims, evidence, and sources.
possibilities.novelty_hypothesis: The tool could become the quality-control spine for all research outputs.
possibilities.next_test: Parse claim maps and source registries for missing links and citation metadata.
